issues.detail: Covers the happy path and a few caveats (buffering proxies, git identity, Marko 5 migration), but gives little troubleshooting for compile or hydration errors, no guidance on testing, and the Marko 5 migration notes are only a one-line summary.

scenarios.name: streaming-products-page-with-error-handling
scenarios.rationale: B uses a `static async` function that throws on non-ok, `<await|products|=...>` in `<try>` with `<@placeholder>` and `<@catch|err|>`, and `<for ... by="id">`, so it matches the rubric closely; A uses a promise const rather than a static async function and omits `by="id"`, so it only partly matches.

scenarios.name: migrate-marko5-class-component
scenarios.rationale: Both convert the counter to `<let/count=0>` with an inline `count++` handler and the async section to `<try><await|data|=promise>` with `<@placeholder>` on `<try>`, but A also notes that unmigrated pages can stay on `marko@5` until each is converted, which B omits and B adds a hedge about the API.
